Includes auto-router, PDF fast-path, and result cache.

descriptions.profile: Your local display name, avatar and bio — synced to companion devices and included in backups.
descriptions.providers: AI provider API keys, models, and connection settings.
descriptions.remoteControl: Local HTTP listener for inbound triggers, plus webhook signing and custom headers for outbound calls.
descriptions.sandbox: OS / microVM sandbox health and tool execution policy
descriptions.scheduledTasks: Configure cron-style automation, agent permissions, and resource limits
descriptions.search: Web search providers (Tavily, Brave, Bing, Google, Perplexity, Exa…), defaults, cache, safety and source verification.
descriptions.security: Biometric guards for sensitive actions and privacy controls
descriptions.sidebar: Pin, reorder, or hide the left navigation rail items.
descriptions.skills: Reusable instruction blobs appended to system prompts.
descriptions.slashCommands: Built-in, custom, and plugin-contributed slash commands — browse, search, and copy a command into the composer.
descriptions.sourceControl: AI commit-message generation and other Git panel preferences.
descriptions.speech: Voice input (STT) language and microphone, plus read-aloud (TTS) provider, voice and auto-play.
descriptions.subagents: Sub-agent templates and live runtime — spawn focused workers from a parent agent for research, code review, content, or analysis sub-tasks.

toolSettings.coreFilesDesc: grep / glob / read / ls / edit / multi_edit / write / bash / TodoWrite — the unified file-tool suite that gives non-Anthropic models full codebase access. Read-only tools run freely; mutating tools require per-call approval.

toolSettings.environmentManagementDesc: Read environment variables and system info. Secret-shaped keys (KEY/TOKEN/SECRET/PASSWORD) are redacted unless the agent explicitly opts in.
toolSettings.fileExtrasDesc: hash, diff, content_search, file_info and other ops not covered by the SDK's built-in Read / Write / Glob / Grep.
toolSettings.gitOperationsDesc: Structured wrappers for git status, diff, log, branch, remote, tag, and repo inspection. Read-only.
toolSettings.lspIntelligenceDesc: Language-server-backed code navigation — go-to-definition, find references, hover types, document symbols, and live diagnostics. Desktop only; language servers spawn lazily on first use.
toolSettings.permissionsDesc: Tools that require approval pop up a per-call dialog. Add a tool to the always-allow list (below) to skip the prompt. Disable a category to remove its tools from the agent entirely.
toolSettings.processManagementDesc: List, search, start and terminate local processes. Off by default — start/terminate are high-risk.
toolSettings.selfInvokeCardDesc: Let the agent call tools to drive itself — load a skill's instructions, or run a slash command. Host-routed; works in the browser and the CLI. Off by default.
toolSettings.shellExecutionDesc: Allowlist + blocklist + dangerous-pattern guard for shell commands. Off by default — overlaps SDK Bash and is high-risk.
toolSettings.skillToolDesc: Expose the Skill tool so the agent can load a skill's instructions mid-task.
toolSettings.slashToolDesc: Expose the SlashCommand tool so the agent can run a registered slash command. Built-in UI commands return guidance to run them from the composer.
toolSettings.teamCollabToolDesc: Let teammates collaborate during a team run — message peers, share the blackboard, open or vote in a consensus, and delegate sub-tasks. Only applies to Agent Team sessions.
toolSettings.terminalReplDesc: Agent-private persistent PTY sessions backed by node-pty (lazy loaded). Use for stateful REPLs (python / sql / claude-code) where the agent needs to hold state across multiple writes. Orthogonal to the dock-relay path — REPL is invisible to the user.
toolSettings.title: Built-in tools

tools.checkProgramAllowed: Test whether a program would be allowed to start_process.
tools.contentSearch: Search file contents (substring or regex) with line numbers.
tools.coreApplyPatch: Apply a unified diff across one or more files atomically (create / modify / delete).
tools.coreBash: Execute a free-form shell command (approval-gated; output keeps the tail).
tools.coreBashOutput: Read new output from a background shell started with bash(run_in_background).
tools.coreEdit: Replace an exact string in a file, with whitespace-tolerant fuzzy fallback.
tools.coreGlob: Find files by glob pattern, sorted by modification time (newest first).
tools.coreGrep: Search file contents with a regex (ripgrep-backed; content / files / count modes).
tools.coreKillShell: Terminate a background shell started with bash(run_in_background).
tools.coreMultiEdit: Apply multiple string replacements to one file atomically.
tools.coreNotebookEdit: Edit a Jupyter notebook cell (replace / insert / delete) by cell id or number.
tools.coreRead: Read a text file with line numbers; pages large files; lists directories.
tools.coreTodoWrite: Update the session task list shown to the user.
tools.coreWrite: Create or overwrite a file (requires a prior read of existing files).
tools.directoryDelete: Delete a directory. Recursive option for non-empty trees.
tools.fileAppend: Append UTF-8 text to a file. Creates the file if missing.
tools.fileBinaryWrite: Write a base64-encoded binary payload to a file.
tools.fileExists: Check if a path exists. Returns isFile / isDirectory.
tools.fileHash: Compute md5 / sha1 / sha256 / sha512 of a file. Read-only.
tools.fileMove: Move a file across or within filesystems.
tools.fileSearch: List files under a directory matching an optional glob and extension filter.
tools.getEnv: Read a single env var. Secrets are redacted unless revealed.
tools.getProcess: Get a single process by PID.
tools.getProcessManagerStatus: Sidecar process manager state and tracked PID count.
tools.getTrackedProcesses: PIDs the agent has started this session.
tools.gitCommit: Create a commit from staged changes. Requires approval.
tools.gitDiff: Diff working tree or staged area.
tools.gitHistory: Commit history for a path or set of paths.
tools.gitLog: Recent commits with hash / author / date / subject.
tools.gitRepoInspect: Top-level path, current branch, HEAD hash, upstream.
tools.gitStage: Stage files for commit (git add). Requires approval.
tools.gitTag: List tags, optionally filtered by glob.
tools.listEnv: List process env vars. Secrets are redacted unless revealed.
tools.lspDiagnostics: Get current compiler / linter diagnostics for a file.
tools.lspDocumentSymbols: List the symbols (classes, functions, variables) defined in a file.
tools.lspFindReferences: Find all references to the symbol at a position.
tools.lspGotoDefinition: Find where the symbol at a position is defined.
tools.lspHover: Get type / signature / documentation for the symbol at a position.
tools.searchProcesses: Find processes whose name contains a substring.
tools.shellExecuteAdvanced: Run a single program with argv, gated by allowlist + blocklist + dangerous-pattern guard. Always requires approval.
tools.startProcess: Start a program from the allowlist. Requires approval.
tools.systemInfo: Platform, arch, node version, cpu, memory, uptime, hostname.
tools.terminalReplRead: Drain accumulated REPL output (default: destructive read). Returns '{data, truncated, exited, exitCode}'.
tools.terminalReplSpawn: Open a persistent interactive PTY (e.g. python / sql REPL). Returns sessionId for subsequent writes / reads.
tools.terminalReplWrite: Write bytes into a REPL session's stdin. Non-blocking — pair with terminal_repl_read.
tools.terminateProcess: Terminate a PID (default: only PIDs this session started).
tools.topMemoryProcesses: Top N processes by resident memory.

update.description: Patches an existing team's roster or orchestration mode.
update.label: Update team

readRecent.description: Read the recent-commands ring (command, exit code, ended-at) of a terminal dock tab.
readRecent.label: Read terminal history

script.description: Run a script file (.sh / .ps1 / .py / .js / …) under the right interpreter, detected from its extension or overridden explicitly.
script.label: Run script file

close.description: Close a terminal session opened earlier in this run. Leftover sessions are closed automatically when the run ends.
close.label: Close terminal session

open.description: Open a persistent terminal session (visible dock tab, or a headless private shell with unattended mode) for multi-step command runs.
open.label: Open terminal session

run.description: Run one command in a session opened earlier in this run and wait for its exit code.
run.label: Run in terminal session

waitForExit.description: Block until the command currently running in a terminal dock tab finishes, then route on its exit code.
waitForExit.label: Wait for terminal exit

ingest.description: Queues a new source for the twin's ingest pipeline.
ingest.label: Twin ingest

rag.description: Runs RAG over a twin's vector store and returns the top-K chunks.
rag.label: Twin RAG

classify.description: LLM-based classification into one of N labels.
classify.label: Classify

embed.description: Generate an embedding vector for semantic similarity.
embed.label: Embed text

extract.description: Structured extraction (JSON schema) from free-form text.
extract.label: Extract data

prompt.description: Direct LLM call. Uses the configured provider routing.
prompt.label: AI prompt

group.description: Visual group around several nodes. Has no execution.
group.label: Group frame

note.description: Free-text note placed on the canvas. Has no execution.
note.label: Sticky note

code.description: Custom JS expression with a 5s timeout.
code.label: Code

template.description: Render a mustache-style template string against the upstream data.
template.label: Template

transform.description: Map / filter / reduce / sort over an input array or object.
transform.label: Transform

gate.description: Pass/fail verdict for an eval run against thresholds; branches on pass / fail.
gate.label: Eval gate

run.description: Run an eval dataset against a chat / team / workflow target and output pass rates.
run.label: Run eval

branch.description: Routes execution down one of two branches based on a condition.
branch.label: If / else

break.description: Stops the innermost loop after the current iteration.
break.label: Break

continue.description: Skips the rest of the current loop iteration.
continue.label: Continue

join.description: Joins parallel branches with all/any/race semantics.
join.label: Join

loop.description: Repeats a sub-graph for-each / while / N times.
loop.label: Loop

set.description: Assigns a value to a workflow-scoped variable.
set.label: Set variable

split.description: Fans out to multiple branches that run concurrently.
split.label: Split (parallel)

subworkflow.description: Invokes another workflow as a step.
subworkflow.label: Run subworkflow

switch.description: Multi-way branch on the value of an expression.
switch.label: Switch

wait.description: Pauses for a fixed duration or until a wake-up event arrives.
wait.label: Wait

http.description: Call an external HTTP API with retries and timeout.
http.label: HTTP request

respond.description: Respond to the inbound webhook trigger with a payload.
respond.label: Webhook respond

extract.description: Run OCR on an image or PDF (URL, base64, or screen) and output its text.
extract.label: Extract text (OCR)

message.description: Fires when a user sends a message in a bound character session.
message.label: On chat message

inbound.description: Fires when a message arrives on a connected platform (Telegram, Slack, ...).
inbound.label: Incoming message

cron.description: Fires on a cron schedule. Backed by the Tauri scheduler when running.
cron.label: On schedule

event.description: Fire when a UIA focus / structure / property event matches.
event.label: On UIA event

webhook.description: Fires when GitHub posts a webhook (PR opened, Issue labeled, push, …). Verifies x-hub-signature-256.
webhook.label: On GitHub event

completed.description: Fires when a /goal reaches a terminal status (completed, stopped, budget/turn/timeout).
completed.label: On goal completed

manual.description: Fires when you click Run in the editor.
manual.label: Run manually

team.description: Internal trigger fired by the agent-team synthesizer when a team run starts. Not hand-authored.
team.label: On team run start

command.description: Fires when a command finishes in a user-spawned terminal dock tab. Scope by session, project, exit status, or a command substring.
command.label: On terminal command

webhook.description: Fires when an HTTP request hits the workflow's webhook path.
webhook.label: On webhook
